cohort: 125 patients with antenatally suspected and pathologically confirmed PAS disorders
finding: Patients with PAS disorders who underwent emergency cesarean hysterectomy experienced higher maternal morbidity (increased blood loss, coagulopathy, bladder injury, blood transfusion, and urinary tract injury) and poorer perinatal outcomes (lower gestational age at birth) compared to those who had electively scheduled procedures.
gest_age: Lower in the emergency group (31.55 weeks) compared to the elective group (35.19 weeks)
